title: Personal Credit Cards: days past due for suspension and charge-off by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: suspension and charge-off thresholds

This quick reference covers the Personal Credit Cards line and gives, for every card tier, the number of days past due at which charging privileges are suspended and the number of days past due at which the balance is charged off.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Days past due at which charging privileges are suspended | Days past due at which the balance is charged off |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 60 days | 180 days |
| College Rewards Visa | 60 days | 180 days |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 60 days | 180 days |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 60 days | 180 days |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 60 days | 180 days |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 60 days | 180 days |

## Equivalent reading

- The two thresholds are the same on every tier of the line.
- Both are counted in whole days past due.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does any tier suspend earlier or charge off later than another?**
A: No. Every tier suspends at 60 days past due and charges off at 180 days past due.
